title: Clancy Meeting 4

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: You ready for the big kahuna kid? The real meat on the bones? This one's for free.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ready for the big kahuna kid? The real meat on the bones? This one's for free.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: It's very simple, maybe the easiest to learn, but by far the most important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's very simple, maybe the easiest to learn, but by far the most important.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I'm waffling on like I always do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. I'm sorry. I'm waffling on like I always do.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Oh, it's a good one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it's a good one.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Ok here it is... don't be me. That's it. Whatever you do, just don't be me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok here it is... don't be me. That's it. Whatever you do, just don't be me.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I'm nothing kid, I'm nothing to nobody. They say you die twice. The first time when you die, and the second time when nobody remembers you anymore. Well for me that's gonna be the same damn day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm nothing kid, I'm nothing to nobody. They say you die twice. The first time when you die, and the second time when nobody remembers you anymore. Well for me that's gonna be the same damn day.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: That's just it kid. Turns out the only thing I couldn't sell in the end was myself...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's just it kid. Turns out the only thing I couldn't sell in the end was myself...

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: And scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And scene.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I really had you going didn't I? Had you eating out of the palm of my hand!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really had you going didn't I? Had you eating out of the palm of my hand!

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: And that's it. That's the final lesson. You can't be a great salesman, if you ain't a great writer. You gotta make the customer feel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And that's it. That's the final lesson. You can't be a great salesman, if you ain't a great writer. You gotta make the customer feel.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well kid, you've graduated from the Pantermino International Sales School. You're ready to go out there and feel the wind against your eyeballs. You could sell slime-mold to a sea dog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well kid, you've graduated from the Pantermino International Sales School. You're ready to go out there and feel the wind against your eyeballs. You could sell slime-mold to a sea dog.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Also for tax reasons, old Clancy gotta move some funds around. Think you could take care of some Lims for me? Reinvest them or something? Just don't tell the Corpsters you got it from me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Also for tax reasons, old Clancy gotta move some funds around. Think you could take care of some Lims for me? Reinvest them or something? Just don't tell the Corpsters you got it from me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As ready as I'll ever be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As ready as I'll ever be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As ready as I'll ever be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As ready as I'll ever be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Get on with it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get on with it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow, sounds like a doozy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, sounds like a doozy!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People will remember you. You're a great salesman!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People will remember you. You're a great salesman!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: People will remember you. You're a great salesman!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: People will remember you. You're a great salesman!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's what you get for working in sales.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what you get for working in sales.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's what you get for working in sales.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's what you get for working in sales.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean, it was a bit on the nose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, it was a bit on the nose.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean, it was a bit on the nose.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean, it was a bit on the nose.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's given me a lot to think about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's given me a lot to think about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's given me a lot to think about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's given me a lot to think about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks...
